_comment_first_start: Most of these values are only read on the FIRST start: they are copied into dashboard/data/dashboard.db and from then on edited in the admin area (Settings tab). Exceptions that always come from this file: auth.superadmin, web.bind, event_receiver, user_database.user_agent.
_comment_branding: Optional: own logo and favicon, e.g. "/static/n8schicht-icon.svg" (files in dashboard/static/) or a full URL. Leave empty for the DMR Die N8schicht logo.

auth._comment: Login and user management (SQLite: dashboard/data/dashboard.db). The superadmin below is the only account set here; it logs into the admin area and creates admins and users there. Prefer password_hash over password: python3 -m dashboard.auth hash-password. public_dashboard=false means nothing is visible without login. IP addresses are only ever shown to admins.

https._comment: HTTPS with automatic Let's Encrypt certificates. Needs: sudo apt install certbot, the domain pointing to this server, and ports 80 and 443 open. Port 80 answers the Let's Encrypt challenge and redirects to HTTPS; web.port then also redirects. Renewal runs automatically. Use letsencrypt=false with cert_file/key_file for your own certificates; staging=true for testing.

web._comment: LISTENING socket for browsers (the web UI). Unrelated to the HBlink4 event link below. 'bind' is a bind address: '0.0.0.0' for all IPv4 interfaces, '::' for all interfaces on a dual-stack host, '127.0.0.1' for local access only.

event_receiver._comment: LISTENING socket for HBlink4's incoming event connection. HBlink4 dials in and sends the events; the dashboard only sends sync_request back over the connection it accepted. Naming convention: bind_* = an address we listen on, host_* = an address we connect out to. bind_ipv4/bind_ipv6 accept '0.0.0.0'/'::' for all interfaces, or '' to disable that family. transport, port and unix_socket must match the 'dashboard' section of config/config.json.

user_database._comment: Radio ID to callsign lookups, downloaded daily from radioid.net. Only the countries listed below are loaded, so a radio from anywhere else shows '-' in Last Heard. Add yours using the exact name radioid.net uses, e.g. ["New Zealand"], or use "all" (no list brackets) for every country. See dashboard/README.md for when a change takes effect.

freeradioid._comment: Also loads the IDs registered at FreeRadioID.net (no country filter, ~400 IDs incl. non-amateur IDs) and marks them in Last Heard. To use FreeRadioID's combined list (radioid.net + FreeRadioID) as the main source instead, set source_url above to https://freeradioid.net/api/subscriber_ids.csv

Avatars and profiles from FreeRadioID.net in the station detail view and Last Heard. {id} is replaced by the radio ID. Set avatar_url to "" to turn avatars off, profile_lookup to false to stop live profile lookups.
